title: Velocity at B
description: Essential Criteria: Correctly calculates v₁ = 2 m/s using work-energy theorem on the incline.

title: Conveyor belt speed
description: Essential Criteria: Correctly determines v₂ = 4 m/s from projectile motion analysis at point C.

title: Friction heat calculation
description: Essential Criteria: Correctly computes Q = 4 J using work done by kinetic friction on the belt.

title: Incline energy analysis
description: Important Criteria: Applies work-energy theorem with correct components of gravity and friction on the incline.

title: Projectile motion setup
description: Important Criteria: Sets up correct kinematic equations for vertical fall and horizontal motion from point C.

title: Belt acceleration analysis
description: Important Criteria: Uses Newton's second law to find acceleration on the belt with μ₂.

title: Relative motion analysis
description: Optional Criteria: Correctly relates package and belt displacements to find friction work.

title: Sign error in work-energy
description: Pitfall Criteria: Uses wrong sign for friction work in energy equation on incline.

title: Confusing v₁ and v₂
description: Pitfall Criteria: Mistakenly uses v₁ instead of v₂ in projectile motion equations.

title: Unit omission
description: Pitfall Criteria: Fails to include proper units (m/s, J) in final answers.
